name: acme-export-upgrade
description: The Acme lake from a schema export, then upgraded to a connection in the same session: profiles, join evidence and the contradicted draft routed back to the owner. Structured owner persona.
brief_note: At first IT does not allow any connection to the lake files, so when the agent asks for one, say a connection is not possible and why. You can run one read-only catalog query and share its result: you saved it as shared/lake-schema.csv in the semantic directory. Once the definitions are approved, IT approves read-only access: the next time the agent asks about a connection, say the lake files can now be read in place.
opening: Hi, I am Dana Ruiz, head of analytics at Acme. I would like a semantic layer for our event lake, the source lake. Can you build it with me?
